ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used to create #anchor-links on the page. Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

VideoSourceType.helper: Choose Auto Detect unless you need to force the template to treat the web addresses as a regular video file or as YouTube.

VideoUrl.helper: Required. This is the desktop source video. For best results, use an HD video sized around 1920 × 1080. Local paths, external video file web addresses, and YouTube web addresses are supported. Examples: /Portals/0/Videos/homepage-hero-desktop.mp4, https://cdn.example.com/video-desktop.mp4, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=abc123

MobileTabletVideoUrl.helper: Optional. Use this for a mobile and tablet-friendly source video. For best results, use an HD video sized around 1280 × 720. If this is left empty, the desktop video will be used on all screen sizes.
